sections.kicker: Prepared for Way Out Visual Co. by Atla · November 2026
sections.lead: We looked at your Instagram the way a new customer would. Here is what stood out, in order of weight.
sections.thesis: Way Out's photos already sell hotels. The bio sells three services.
sections.keep: The warm film-style colour of the grid. It looks like one eye across Sicily, Paris and Palm Springs.

sections.label: Front door
title: Three things people
meet first.
Three things

pins.quote: Storytelling + social strategy for hotels, travel + hospitality brands.
pins.what: The bio lists three services for three kinds of client.
pins.why: Storytelling, strategy and hotels, travel and hospitality read like a menu, so a hotel cannot tell what it is hiring.
pins.how: Say the one thing Way Out does best for hotels.
pins.label: Your bio
pins.cost: They are compared with every hotel photographer on price.

pins.quote: Hospitality is experienced digitally long before the guest arrives.
pins.what: The best sentence is on a tile that does not look like the rest.
pins.why: The blue sea tile in typewriter type breaks the warm photo grid.
pins.how: Say it in the same visual language as the photographs.
pins.label: Your grid
pins.cost: The idea is separate from the work that proves it.

pins.quote: shot for @marlowespalmsprings grand opening last week
pins.what: The clients are named in the captions only.
pins.why: Marlowe, Proper and Drift are the proof that hotels already trust Way Out.
pins.how: Put two or three of the names in the profile.
pins.label: Your captions
pins.cost: A new hotel sees a photographer, not a photographer hotels already hire.
